units: Gen. R. s. 93 (play on bi, Gen. XLIV, 18) ב׳ אתה מעביר עלינו thou passest violence over us (thou treatest us unjustly).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20:10">Ex. R. s. 20</cite> <he>שמא … ב׳ וכ׳</he> do I ever wrong any creature? <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:20">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> (play on <he>בבאה</he> <cite ref="Ezekiel 8:5">Ez. VIII, 5</cite>) <he>הא ב׳ רבא לעלמא וכ׳</he> Oh, this great wrong in this world, v. infra. *<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:3:2">Y. Ned. III, 38ᵃ</cite> <he>כן … כורוסתי בייה</he> that is the way one says to his neighbor (read <he>כריזסתי</he> χαρίζεσθαι βίᾳ) to do a favor perforce (ref. to an invitation accompanied with a vow in case of refusal).

senses.gloss: interj. (= h. וי) woe! help! Yoma 69ᵇ ב׳ ב׳ וכ׳ woe, woe, it is this (the tempter) that destroyed the Temple &c.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 97b:5">Yeb. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ ב׳ מאה וכ׳</he> woe, woe over the brother who is &c.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17">Lev. R. s. 17</cite>, end (play on <he>בבאה</he>, v. supra) <he>ב׳ ב׳ תותבא וכ׳</he> woe, woe, that the stranger dislodges the owner (idolatry in the Temple).
